verdict.rationale: Undermind documents an autonomous deep literature review that plans its own searches, follows citations, and stops only when new searches stop finding relevant papers. Community reports confirm these jobs run for minutes, so the long-running, unattended part of the story is supported. The documented notifications are recurring alerts about newly published papers on saved topics, which is a different feature from a one-off alert that a submitted job has finished, so the notify-when-ready part is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented notification when a research job completes, evidence that jobs keep running if the user leaves the session, independent hands-on corroboration of unattended operation.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can start a long research job that keeps working unattended and notifies me when the result is ready

citations.quote: Runs a deep literature review from an open-ended research goal and produces a ranked list of papers with a written synthesis. Plans its own searches, follows citations and key authors, and stops only when new searches stop finding relevant papers.
